title: ICICI Manchester United Signature credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Manchester United Signature variant with premium privileges, including lounge access, shopping rewards, and exclusive MUFC experiences.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Get upto 25% discount on movie tickets.|Spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: INOX
benefitRows.offer: Get upto 25% discount on movie tickets.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Go to www.inoxmovies.com and select movies/events to be booked.|On payment page, search for the relevent offer, add card details and click on 'Apply Offer'.|Offer will be applied and the payment amount adjusted accordingly.
